g.text: Paper count and L1 speakers for the major languages
Persian: 80% of the papers, about 60% of the family's speakers. Red: fewer than one paper per million speakers.
Pashto has twice Kurdish's speakers but a third of its papers.
Computationally Invisible (SilkRoadNLP submission), §3 and Figure 2; speakers from Table 1. Multilingual papers count once per language
